Bug_Details:
Calling getAnnotation on an annotation that is not retained at runtime Calling getAnnotation on an annotation that does not have its Retention set to
RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME will always return null.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded by using a custom annotation that is not retained at runtime, and then attempting to retrieve it using the getAnnotation method in the showBug method.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testShowBug' calls the'showBug' method which tries to retrieve a NonRuntimeAnnotation. Since the NonRuntimeAnnotation is not retained at runtime, getAnnotation method returns null. This assertion fails, triggering the bug.
